dedupe_keys.name: wtbs2025 wind turbine blade defect images

description: The WTBs2025 team publishes a wind-turbine blade surface-defect image set. The Figshare ZIP holds JPG pictures and text labels organized in nine folders for cracks, film damage, lightning strikes, coating loss, erosion, oil leakage, pinholes, stains and localized damage. The article reports 7,544 images, including augmented lightning-strike examples. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. The labels can train or compare defect detection before turbine-maintenance or reliability simulation. Coverage is sampled wind-farm blade surfaces, not a complete turbine fleet. A caveat is that augmented images should be separated from real observations during testing, or performance may be overstated. Labels do not give blade age, load history or failure probability. Own Figshare metadata and the article's Data Records were read without downloading the image archive or testing label accuracy. The augmentation code is a separate related public repository.
